in_sanskrit.name: त्रिनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has three lords or masters. In Hinduism, this name is given to those who believe in three main deities: Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.

in_hindi.name: त्रिनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The master of the three purposes of human life: Dharma (duty), Artha (prosperity), and Kama (desire).

in_tamil.name: திரிநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has three revered goddesses: Lakshmi, Saraswati, and Parvati.

in_telugu.name: ట్రినాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of Adhya-Mahesh (the divine trinity of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva).

in_marathi.name: Trinath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trinath is a name derived from Hindu mythology, signifying the belief in three principal gods - Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. It represents the idea of unified power and divine protection.

in_bengali.name: Trinath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Three Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Trinath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Trinath is a name derived from Hindu mythology, signifying the belief in three principal gods - Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. It represents the idea of unified power and divine protection.
